title: plugin-list: a condition chip shows the raw operator id (is_not_null, less_than, ...) for operators only the advanced panel writes
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Found by the #36256 dev while measuring the drill dialog in a browser (PR #36461). Filed by the seat. Screenshots are held in the project files under `repo-objectstack-7/card-36256/`.

## What happens

On the CRM Pipeline dashboard, the drill dialogs of the donut slice and of Won This Quarter show the condition chip "Deal Value: is_not_null". `quickOperatorLabel` in `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/conditions/conditionTranslations` returns the raw operator id for operators that only the advanced condition panel writes: `is_not_null`, `is_null`, `less_than`, `greater_than`, `not_equals`. Any list whose conditions carry one of them shows the machine name on its chip.

## To do

1. Give each of those operators a chip label in every locale, reusing the advanced panel's own operator wording.
2. Make the fallback for an unknown operator something a reader can read, never the raw id.
3. Pin the chip text for each operator in en and zh-CN.

## Acceptance

- A drill dialog or list carrying `is_not_null` (and the other four) shows a business label on its chip, for example "Deal Value: is set", and no chip shows an operator id.

## Grade
p2 · area:ux · domain:ui. A machine name on a user-facing chip.
